text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the race unfolds, a certain
Umamusume
watches intently...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And here she comes! Tearing past
Sakura Chiyono
O to claim victory at the
autumn Tenno Sho is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I won't lose... I won't!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The outcome of the race is as good as
decided,
so why...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Why do your eyes still burn with such
intensity?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And she's still in the lead! She's heading
straight
for the goal... and she's wooon!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What incredible skills! Talk about a
talented
racer. She's won the shield with
a spectacular
show of power!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chiyo...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's all right that you didn't win...
I saw
how hard
you were running...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gasp... Huff... Wheeze... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(The wall in front of me...
it's too thick. There's
not a single gap in it that I can
even begin to
grasp at...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(They're brimming with natural talent
leagues
beyond anything I've ever had...
I can see that all
too clearly now.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But so what if they've got natural talent?
Who
cares about a little thing like that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I might be the plainest and most
mediocre racer
out there, but there's no
way I'm going to give up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I won't, because I swore I'm going to
become her
rival!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...You're shining too bright, Chiyo. Why
are you
trying so hard to reach me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I can't look away from your reaching
hands and
brilliant eyes. And to think all
that energy is
directed squarely at me...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Your fangs are bared and your gaze
pinned on a single target. When you
stare at me with those
eyes like a
starving wolf...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...I can barely think straight.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I didn't win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: Which G1 should we prove your runn...
Which G1 will you prove your runni...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Thank you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But before we decide that, I have
something I
need to say to someone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Sakura Chiyono O asks
Maruzensky
to meet her on the roof.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen, you came to watch the autumn
Tenno
Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course. You were running in it, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'm sure you know there's
something I
want to tell you, then.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm still not good enough for you
to
consider me a rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But if you tell me to my face that I'm not
enough,
then I'll train more intensely
than ever.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If you say you need time to think, then
I'll wait
until you're ready.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep running until I reach your
heart.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyo.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And to back up those words, I have a
proposal to
make.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There's a certain race I want to run in
with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's a G1 turf race in Tokyo that
measures a classic distance of 2,400
meters. It fits all the
criteria of your
dream race—the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm talking about the autumn festival
where the
best of the best from around
the world
compete—the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However, I know that I don't have the
skill it
takes to compete against you yet.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So when next year comes, and it's time
for the
Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Please race me there with all you've got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wind blows past them, and though
it's only a
moment, it feels so much
longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Throughout their conversation, the sun
has been
slowly sinking lower toward the
horizon, and it
glints...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
How blindingly bright... I can't pretend
not to see,
can I?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My peak has already passed, and unlike
the sun in
the sky, I doubt I will ever be
able to reach my
zenith again.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A breath of time passes, then
Maruzensky tears
the envelope she's
been holding into pieces.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll still wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with those words, their promise with
each
other takes on a new form.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thanks for coming, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're the only one who would
praise me
for something like that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for deciding our next goal without

discussing it with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: I don't mind. After all, it's your...
I don't mind. After all, it's your...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: Though as your Trainer, I'll still...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Heh.... Haha! Trainer, you're really too
much...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Still, I'm glad I have you in my
corner.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well, we've only got a year to prep, so
let's get
started.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to get stronger, and I want to
kindle Maruzen's passion for running
too. What G1 race
do you think I should
tackle next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stare into her expectant eyes and think.
If her
plan is to come to fruition, we
have two options.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A mile race would be good training to
match the
Hot Rod's speed, which would
point us to the
Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Alternatively, we could hone Chiyono
O's racing instincts against stronger
opponents in the
medium-distance
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I think our best choice is to
go with...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Goal Race is now the Yasuda Kinen.
choice_data_list: The "Yasuda Kinen" on the mile route

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Let me pencil that down in my
Chiyonotes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we decide to compete in the
Yasuda
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Goal Race is now the Takarazuka
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Let me pencil that down in my
Chiyonotes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we decide to compete in the

Takarazuka Kinen.
